title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E16 — Wedding Bell Blues
When Mark's demanding employer, P.J., tells him she is going to marry her old boyfriend and quit her job, Mark has to decide if he should tell her a secret that could make her cancel the wedding. Queen Latifah guest stars and sings "Just Another Day.".

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E17 — Truth or Consequences
Mark and Vanessa make a bet on who can go the longest without telling a lie.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E18 — Trading Places
When Vanessa applies for a job at a conservative Christian radio station, she tells the manager that Mark is her husband and Geneva is her wild cousin.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E19 — Pros and Convicts
When Vanessa shows Geneva how to have a good time, Geneva hits on a police officer who mistakes them both as prostitutes. They both are arrested, and Mark is arrested while trying to bail them out of jail.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E20 — Double Cheeseburger, Hold the Diploma
P.J. threatens to discharge Mark when his student, Earvin, quits school. Geneva can't afford to buy a new bicycle for her daughter, Nicole.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E21 — Groom and Doom
Mark introduces Geneva to a college teacher who asks her to marry him.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E22 — Hangin' with Mrs. Cooper
Mark plots to reunite his parents after his mother, Dorothy (Ja'net DuBois), leaves her husband of 35 years and moves in with Mark. Richard Roundtree guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E1 — Call Me Irresponsible
Mark avoids P.J.'s phone calls and learns, too late, that she had good news. Geneva plays a trick on Vanessa to teach Nicole a lesson.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E2 — My Bodyguard
Mark teaches Tyler how to be a tough guy so that he can protect Nicole against a bully at school. When Tyler's approach doesn't work, Geneva goes up to the school and makes a big scene, scaring the bully away. Vanessa takes care of her boss' prized orchid.

title: Webster
description:
S1 E17 — Secrets of The Night
Webster is always nervous and it's resulted with him having a bed-wetting problem.

title: Webster
description:

Webster gets nightmares because the teacher he has a crush on wants to read his composition aloud.

title: Webster
description:

Uncle Phil and the Papadapolises all go to court to battle for custody of Webster.

title: Webster
description:

Webster helps the school janitor go back to being a magician.

title: Webster

The Papadapolis' and Webster all try and save the Tracadero diner from being demolished.

title: Moesha
description:

Frank takes Hakeem to the father/son “lock-in” at the local church, to encourage open communication and trust between fathers and sons.

title: Moesha
description:

Mo has been dating Bridgewood classmate Jeremy since her break up with Q.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E13 — Talk Of The Town
Mo organizes a Town Hall meeting when local merchants and neighbors threaten to shut down the Bomb Bay because of the young noisy crowds.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E14 — He Ain’t Heavy, He’s Dee’s Brother
Mo gets a crush on Dee’s very attractive younger brother when he comes to visit.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E16 — It’s My Paper And I’ll Cry If I Want To
Mo decides to publish her own Bridgewood newspaper when editor Mary Ellen refuses to add her to the staff of the existing paper.

S2 E12 — Matchmakers
In efforts to find Rose a permanent mate, Mary and Sandra resort to a video dating service that transforms Rose into a Tina Turner look-a-like which eventually leads to an embarrassing and hilarious outcome when she meets her match.

S2 E13 — Check Snub
When Pearl (Helen Martin) is refused her social security check because the computer lists her as deceased, Mary (Marla Gibbs), Rose (Alaina Reed) and Sandra (Jackée), join in the battle against bureaucracy, only to land themselves in jail.

S2 E14 — Author, Author
Sandra writes a steamy romance novel based on characters that are suspiciously similar to her friends at 227.

S2 E15 — The Working Game
Mary's new job with a travel agency takes her out-of-town on business with her boss, leaving a jealous Lester at home. Special guest appearance by Garrett Morris.
